spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the feature's core semantic (one storage, several simultaneous typed readings, zero copies) with genuine TypedArray aliasing over one ArrayBuffer, and shows the WGSL before/after honestly labelled as the CPU analogue — never claiming the GPU path ran.

interactive.rationale: 16 editable hex bytes recompute four live views on every keystroke; two preset buttons (random, float pattern) exercise the aliasing both directions.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises live byte-level reinterpretation with the WGSL comparison; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Invalid hex clamps to 0; float formatting handles NaN/Inf/exponent ranges; the u16 view shows sub-word packing.

conformance.rationale: The suite covers the detection surfaces; this page teaches the semantic those surfaces gate, without inventing GPU claims.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: float preset loaded [1.5, -2.25, π, 100], editing byte b0 to 0xff changed f32[0] to 1.50003 with the matching u32 reading — the aliasing arithmetic verified end-to-end; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; ≥44px hex inputs; view rows on paper (AA).

accessibility.rationale: Every byte input is labelled (b0–b15) in a labelled group; view rows are aria-live text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Byte grid drops from 8 to 4 columns under 500px; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.
